30 October 2026. Principal construction and exact internal certificate.

RESULT

Keep the same leading F=F_* and the same full twelve-dimensional cubic
space as in PROOF.txt. Let p be ANY globally ROC polynomial with leading
cF, c>0. Consider the actual periodic potential

 psi(x,y)=e1 sin x+e2 sin y
       +(e1+e2) sin(x+y-delta1)
       +(1/2,1/4) sin(2x+y-delta1-delta2).                  (1)

For ALL real delta1,delta2, means M, overall amplitudes rho and common
proper output rotations, one has

        <p(M+rho Dpsi)>-p(M)>=(c/200)<|rho Dpsi|^4>.        (2)

Thus a pattern with TWO OVERLAPPING cubic resonances is controlled,
including the fourth-order interference between them. The four relative
amplitudes in (1) are fixed. They are not claimed arbitrary. Domain
translations account for the other two individual wave phases.

Moreover, any finite collection of blocks from (1) and the arbitrary-
amplitude triad class of PROOF.txt can be combined at frequency scales
9^j, with independent phases, output rotations and overall amplitudes.
The SAME constant c/200 holds for the total gradient, independently
of the finite number of blocks.

This is still a restricted variational theorem. Arbitrary resonance
networks, unrestricted relative amplitudes of the overlapping block,
and global QC of the original full polynomial face remain open.
